findings.claim: The rewrite of the MemoryEnforcement text drops the sentence that the memorycard plugin adds memorycard context to new main sessions. The claim still cites runtime:TestMemorycardPluginPutsTheMemorycardContextOnTheSystemPromptOfANewSession, so that test now backs behaviour the text no longer describes. The commit says it adds only one declaration sentence, but this edit also removes an existing statement. The required-phrase list in opencode_declaration_test.go no longer pins the dropped sentence, so nothing catches the removal.

evidence: Only the diff was reviewed; the helper functions it calls (queryArgs, gateInput, sourceHook, assertDenied, encoded, newFakeEngine, runPluginWithEngine) are not visible, so their existence and signatures are assumed.
The fake engine script change keeps the old answer.<event> fallback, and the per-call answer.<event>.<n> file takes precedence only when it exists, so existing tests are unaffected.
The new bridge test and the new cmd subtest look consistent with their stated purpose.
